body.text: A word on the duty, since nobody else at {param:town} will write it and somebody should.
The rate is {perception:burden}. We traded {param:trade} this month, and the merchants took their share of it before the wagons were loaded.
The people are {perception:spirits}. I say only that they notice, and that they talk.
I am not asking you to change it. I am asking you to know it.
